label: TP
reason: User-supplied Referer header flows directly into param via nextElement(), undergoes URL decoding, then passes through doSomething which returns the decoded value unchanged. The returned value is placed into an array and printed via format() with %s substitution, allowing XSS. There is no effective sanitization or neutralization on this path.

evidence.note: Referer -> param -> decode -> doSomething -> return -> format sink
